author: asmodangold
quote:
This is how I remember the game back in 2000 when I was 8 years old. A true masterpiece with a refined ORIGINAL soundtrack. I Literally had goosebumps all the time during the forest temple dungeon because of the music and how eerie, mysterious yet curiosity inducing the music makes you feel like.
The voice acting was a cherry on top and friendly advice, leave the language on japanese for voice acting, you'll thank me later.
Overall, a masterfully made remake for the best game of all time, Literally made me feel what games should feel like nowadays. Thank you Nintendo, Thank you Legend of Zelda <3
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: asmodangold
quote:
Working 9 hours, coming back from work, having something to eat and wanting to play a game and detach from real life problems.
Start the game, end up fixing a house for a gf who ended up in jail because of her stubborness of "YAS QUEEN" personality, taking a haircut, getting fit, making her happy with everything she wants, buying her flowers, while she is sending her number to other people calling them "babe" , all of this at 30 FPS. And let's not mention the fact that you are limited in what cars you can steal, you can modify and so on, AND what you can shoot and what not. gee I wonder why... Slop ****. Definitely not revolutionary despite the awesome graphics. I mean, the graphics are the only thing that stood out this year and I can say it BARELY from other games. besides that, it's a downgrade for the legacy what Rockstar and the name "Grand Theft Auto" stood for.
